dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible along the lateral flank with sharp dark perimeters transitioning to lighter grey interiors. The edges of the most prominent rings exhibit irregular, undulating geometry rather than perfect circularity.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated in the anterior neck region and scattered along the lower ventral-lateral edge, characterized by a lack of internal gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four primary macro-annuli on the mid-lateral surface form an irregular, elongated trapezoidal spatial relationship relative to the longitudinal axis of the body.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of nested concentric ring patterns where smaller high-contrast loops are situated within the interior zones of larger macro-annuli.
